backend: Original FIFO/vsync, maximum_frame_latency+1=2 drawables, presentDrawable before commit, nontransactional branch. No atTime or afterMinimumDuration in executed queue present path.
prior_hypotheses: Separate present submission insufficient in completed native paired control; transaction and supplied-drawable link candidates previously rejected, not repeated.
new_boundary: View-linked CADisplayLink observes Core Animation reported timestamp/target/duration without providing or acquiring GPU drawables. Callback does not request a frame or call renderer/presentation methods.
clock_contract: SDK CADisplayLink.h declares normal Core Animation conventions: Mach host time converted to seconds. Duration read only inside callback, not before first callback.
lifecycle: Main-thread runloop callback, fixed8192scalar slots. Stop invalidates before owned link/target release, before application close. Native fixture uses fake link + actual recorder/stop code, no NSApplication/window; does not prove real callbacks.
limits: CADisplayLink timestamps are reported display clocks; no optical scanout, missed-vsync/latch guarantee or compositor cause inferred. Registering observer can perturb wake/scheduling; off/on control and all gaps retained.
